WebCQ is designed to support the following three main features: (a) a change detection robot to discover and detect interesting changes on web pages, (b) a change notification service to deliver fresh information to users, and (c) a proxy cache server to reduce communication tra cs to original information servers.
WebCQ is an information monitoring and notification system on the World Wide Web.
the WebCQ project is a prototype for a large-scale, information change monitoring system that can be used to detect changes to web pages and deliver fresh information to the users in an e cient way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WebCQ provides a framework to monitor and deliver information changes in the Web.
the WebCQ prototype demonstrates that a system can be built that can detect and deliver changes to a wide range of web pages in an e cient manner, with a reasonable level of accuracy.
we have developed a prototype system for detecting, presenting and delivering information change to the users on the Web.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large-scale Web information change monitoring system can be built with a small number of simple and e cient mechanisms.
